description: Generate a PostgreSQL performance report similar to Oracle AWR. Includes database statistics, top queries (requires pg_stat_statements extension), table/index statistics, connection info, and optimization recommendations.

mcp_client.description: Specify the name and version of the MCP client implementation being used (e.g. Copilot, Claude, Cline...)

model.description: The name (and version) of the language model being used by the MCP client to process requests (e.g. gpt-4.1, claude-sonnet-4, llama4...)

name: pg-awr
